Navarea XIX 129/26

72-32.46N 020-21.45E - Transocean Enabler
67-01.63N 005-18.17E - Transocean Norge
65-22.19N 007-21.33E - Transocean Encourage
65-17.16N 007-18.05E - Island Innovator
65-06.61N 006-47.37E - Asgard B

Notes:
A. Rigs are protected by a 500 metre safety zone.
B. For rigs located south of 65N, refer to Navarea I warnings or visit www.ukho.gov.uk/rnw
2. Cancel Navarea XIX 122/26

NAVAREA XIX 114/26

The Norwegian government has decided that Russian fishing vessels may only access the following three ports on the Norwegian mainland:

A. Båtsfjord (NOBJF)
B. Kirkenes (NOKKN)
C. Tromsø (NOTOS)

A ban on access to other mainland Norwegian ports for Russian fishing vessels will apply from 13:22 UTC on 13 October 2022.

Navarea XIX 45/26 is cancelled.

NAVAREA XIX 132/26
List of in-force NAVAREA XIX warnings as of 30 October 2026, 13:38 UTC: 114/26, 129/26 and 132/26. Cancel NAVAREA XIX 130/26.
